subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should the active config file path be shown in the Overview snapshot card, moved to a Settings/Config information area, or remain CLI-only?
rationale: The technical path is narrow, but the linked request leaves placement open and the PR makes an absolute local path more prominent in the UI.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land this display-only approach after branch refresh and real Control UI proof confirm the existing admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

options.title: Move To Settings
options.body: Ask for the same existing `configPath` field to be surfaced in a Settings or Config information area instead of the Overview snapshot card.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline the extra UI exposure and rely on the existing config-path CLI surface for troubleshooting.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land this display-only approach after branch refresh and real Control UI proof confirm the existing admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the route-owned Control UI architecture that owns the current Overview page layout receiving this row.
